wins.label: Strong Q3 Financial Performance
wins.evidence: Consolidated net revenue of $13.1 billion was up 47% year-on-year, and operating profit was up 44% year-on-year.

wins.label: AI Revenue Growth
wins.evidence: AI revenue continues to grow and grow strongly; Q4 revenue guidance of over $3.5 billion.

wins.label: VMware Bookings
wins.evidence: More than 15 million CPU cores of VCF booked, representing over 80% of the total VMware products we booked during the quarter.

wins.label: Non-AI Networking Recovery
wins.evidence: Non-AI networking was up actually 17% sequentially even as it was down 41% year-on-year.

wins.label: Increased Guidance
wins.evidence: Broadcom is raising the outlook for its fiscal 2024 revenue to $51.5 billion and adjusted EBITDA for the year to 61.5%.

risks.label: Economic Uncertainty
risks.evidence: Broadcom reports certain financial measures on a non-GAAP basis. A reconciliation between GAAP and non-GAAP measures is included in the tables attached to today's press release.

risks.label: Competition in AI
risks.evidence: The transformation of the business model of VMware continues to progress very well. In fact, last week, we held a well-attended VMware Explore Conference in Las Vegas, our first as a combined company.

risks.label: Broadband Weakness
risks.evidence: Q3 revenue declined 49% year-on-year to $557 million and represented 8% of semiconductor revenue. Broadband remains weak on a continued pause in telco and service provider spending.

risks.label: Industrial Resale Decline
risks.evidence: Q3 industrial resales of $164 million declined 31% year-on-year.

risks.label: Supply Chain Constraints
risks.evidence: We've gone through your typical down cycle of semiconductors. And we have gone through a down cycle as the ecosystem, as many of our customers, but we're not immune from it, obviously as we try to insulate ourselves from it as much as possible.
